Common Questions

Frequently Asked

Can I finance a car from a private seller?

Yes, we can help finance vehicles bought from private sellers, dealerships, or auctions. We'll also assist with ownership checks.

Is there an age limit on the vehicle?

Different lenders have different policies on vehicle age. We'll match you with lenders who can work with your chosen vehicle.

Can I trade in my current vehicle?

Trade-ins are arranged through the dealership, not through us. However, we can ensure your finance is structured to account for a trade-in value.
